body:

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body:
@deyouslamtec can you please link to the package.xml maintainer entries in the source packages for these users in order to complete the [issue template](https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/blob/latest/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/update_release_team_membership.md).

Linking to the maintainer entry helps us confirm that this request is legitimately coming from the maintainer team of the source package.

comments.author: deyouslamtec
comments.body: @nuclearsandwich Hi，i have linked these users to maintainer entries in package.xml

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: Thanks! implemented in #272 which will deploy shortly.
